item.travelersbackpack.auto_drink_upgrad: Doth drink water and other draughts from thy pack to slake thy thirst
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_allow_: Permit these draughts (use a water bottle or bucket for the cistern)
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_block_: Forbid these draughts (use a water bottle or bucket for the cistern)
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_always: Drink whensoever thy thirst bar be not full
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_half_h: Drink when at least half the draught may serve to slake thy thirst
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_full_h: Drink only when the whole draught may serve to slake thy thirst
